cues: You went to class, ate dal bhat, maybe played football.
Meanwhile, without asking you, your heart pumped about seven thousand two hundred litres of blood.
Your lungs moved over ten thousand litres of air.
And your kidneys filtered one hundred and eighty litres of plasma, then quietly took back almost all of it.
text: Think about one ordinary day. You went to class, ate dal bhat, maybe played football. Meanwhile, without asking you, your heart pumped about seven thousand two hundred litres of blood. Your lungs moved over ten thousand litres of air. And your kidneys filtered one hundred and eighty litres of plasma, then quietly took back almost all of it.
